parts.text: $UPS Q3 2026: revenue $22.9B, +7% Y/Y, as healthcare and SMB growth offset planned volume reductions. Operating margin compressed to 7.6% as costs outpaced sales growth. #earnings #industrials
$PRU Q3 2026: revenue $14.4B, -19% Y/Y, amid Japan sales suspensions and a multi-year strategy to exit emerging markets. Operating cash flow $3.9B. #earnings #insurance
$QCOM Q4 FY26: revenue $10.3B, -8% Y/Y, as lower handset shipments and memory constraints weighed on results, offset by growth in automotive and IoT. Operating margin 13.1%. #earnings #tech

$MDLN Q3 2026: revenue $7.9B, +10% Y/Y, driven by med-surg supply demand. Operating margin 6.4%; operating cash flow $1.0B. Results reflected tariff impacts and distribution center costs. #earnings #medtech

$AMCR Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $6.1B, +7% Y/Y, driven by raw material pass-through and broad volume growth. Operating margin reached 7.4% as energy and distribution costs created headwinds. #earnings #consumer

$GT Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $4.5B, -2% Y/Y, as replacement market weakness and lower tire volumes offset OE gains. Operating margin -4.6% amid manufacturing and cost pressures. #earnings #materials
$MSI Q3 2026: revenue reached $3.4B, up 12% Y/Y, driven by growth across Products and Systems Integration and Software segments, including acquisitions. Operating margin was 23.0%. #earnings #tech
$AFL Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $3.3B, down 31% Y/Y amid net investment losses and strategic portfolio repositioning. Net earnings totaled $303M. #earnings #insurance
$LUMN Q3 2026: revenue $2.7B, down 12% Y/Y with an operating margin of -6.2%, as growth in strategic dark fiber was offset by legacy declines and mass market fiber divestitures. #earnings #telecom
$AFG Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $2.6B, +11% Y/Y, driven by higher net investment income and strong underwriting margins. Net earnings $282M. #earnings #insurance
$OC Q3 2026: revenue $2.5B, -7% Y/Y, amid lower residential and non-residential construction activity. Operating margin -6.1%; operating cash flow $813M. #earnings #materials
$VGNT Q3 2026: revenue $2.5B, +7% Y/Y, driven by growth in Low-Voltage Electrical Architecture. Operating margin was 7.6% as costs rose in line with sales. #earnings #autos
